Headline: #8 Halsted Temporary Reroute at Halsted/Cermak
ShortDescription: 8 Halsted buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to street blockage near Halsted/Cermak.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#8 Halsted buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Halsted, Cermak, Canal, Archer, Halsted Orange Line and over regular route due to street blockage near Halsted/Cermak.

Allow extra travel time.
